sentences.en: You can have mediocre results now, or outstanding results later.
sentences.zh: 你现在可以得到平庸的结果，或者以后取得出色的成绩。

sentences.en: To become popular, you need to be mediocre.
sentences.zh: 要想变得受欢迎，你必须得平庸。

sentences.en: That was a mediocre movie with mediocre actors.
sentences.zh: 那是一部平庸的电影，演员也都很一般。

senses.zh: 平庸的，质量中等偏下的：moderate
